body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within natural weapon range. On a success, deal 1 Acid damage and it suffers -1 Fortitude until its next turn. After this resolves, you may become Unstable; if you do, increase that Fortitude penalty to -2.

surges.html: Until your next turn, reduce damage from Burning or Bleeding by 1, minimum 0.

rider.title: CHIMERA ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Venom Form. While maintained: The first creature you damage with a natural weapon each turn suffers -1 Fortitude until its next turn.
